verdict.note: Approved all. The replacement is theorem-bearing and coherent. The completion value has a nonempty finite supremum, is positive exactly for positive-definite completable specified data, and is m-Lipschitz by zero-fill translation. The score c_pi=[-chi_G]_+ intentionally vanishes at chi_G=0; the explicit positive graph-feasibility margin excludes exactly those completion-boundary failures. Source overlap is compatible with sourcewise i.i.d. concentration and a union bound, and candidate graph collections share their marginal blocks. The covariance concentration, residual and completion moduli, incompatible-order exclusion, both Hausdorff directions, and path-product poset preservation are sound. Sampling and nondegeneracy assumptions are non-crux; graph feasibility and path margins are honestly novel stability conditions. The old subset theorem is subsumed by the clique-edge specialization, and metadata is supported by the new formal definitions, lemma, theorem, and proof. Empty-edge maxima use the stated zero convention.
